chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Abi al-Qasim, mentioning it from the one who narrated it, from Abu Saeed al-Madainy, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Shall I teach you something you should say in the Salat of Ja'far?' So I said, 'Yes'. So he said: 'When you are in the last prostration of the four rak'at, say when you have finished your glorification.'

'Glorious is the One Who is Clothed in Honour and Dignity! Glorious is the One Who Girds Himself with Glory and is Honoured with it! Glorious is the One, to whom glorification is not befitting except Him! Glorious is the One Whose Knowledge encompasses all things! Glorious is the One of Grace and Bounties! Glorious is the One of Power and Benevolence!'

O Allah, I ask You by the knots of Honour from Your Throne, and the peak of Mercy from Your Book, and Your Greatest Name, and Your complete Words which have attained Truth and Justice. Send Blessings upon Muhammad and his Family, and Do such and such with me.'

key_terms.سُبْحَانَ: Glorious is / Glory be to (a formula of glorification)
key_terms.صَلَاةُ جَعْفَرٍ: Salat of Ja'far (a specific recommended supplication)
key_terms.كَلِمَاتُكَ التَّامَّةُ: Your complete Words (referring to the Quran or divine decree)
key_terms.مَعَاقِدُ الْعِزِّ: Knots of Honour (referring to the Throne)

ai.seo_question: What is the text and method for reciting the Salat of Ja'far in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith outlines the 'Salat al-Ja'far', a highly recommended supplication recited in the final prostration of the four-rak'at Fajr prayer or other voluntary prayers. The text emphasizes God's majesty through titles like 'He who wears honor and dignity', linking divine attributes to the efficacy of personal petitions, a practice deeply rooted in Shia devotional tradition for seeking specific needs.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Abu Al-Qasim, mentioning it from the one who narrated it, from Abu Saeed Al-Madainy who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘Shall Iasws teach you something you should be saying in the Salāt of Ja’faras?’ So I said, ‘Yes’. So heasws said: ‘When you were in the last Sajdah from the fourth Rak’at, say when you are free from your Glorification,

‘Glorious is the One Who is Clothed in Honour and the Dignity! Glorious is the One Who Gives with the Glory and is Prestiged with it! Glorious is the One, the Glorification not being befitting for anyone except for Him<sup>azwj</sup>! Glorious is the One Who Reckons everything in His<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge! Glorious is the One with the Favours, and the Bounties! Glorious is the One with the Power and the Benevolence!

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> by the Honourable Splendour from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Throne, and the peak of the Mercy from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Book, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificent Name, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> complete Speech which is complete Truth, and Just. Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the People<sup>asws</sup> of His<sup>azwj</sup> Household, and Do such and such with me’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Abd Allah ibn abu al-Qasim who has narrated from those who narrated to him from abu Sa‘id al-Mada’iniy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘Should I teach you something to say after Salah (prayer) of Ja‘far?’ I replied, ‘Yes, please do so.’ The Imam said, ‘In the last sajdah of the fourth Rak‘at after Tasbihat (plural of Tasbih) say this.

“O the One who has dressed up in majesty and dignity, (You are the one) who is kind with glory and is gracious with glory. (You are), the One, besides whom no one deserves Tasbih (glorification). (You are) the One whose knowledge has encompassed all things, the bountiful and generous, the One who does favors with additional generosity, the powerful and gracious.

I appeal to You through the majestic qualities of Your Throne and the limits of mercy from Your book and through Your great, the most High name and perfect words in all truth and justice. Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad wa ‘Ali Muhammad (O Allah grant Muhammad and his family a compensation worthy of their serving Your cause)’, please make my such and such wishes come true.’””
